what: When a text line passes the height of a figure (character·object) fixed at screen center, if the vertical distance dy between line center and figure center is within 190px above · 255px below (phone 480px and under: 90 · 150), it is pushed outward by sin((1 − |dy|/range) × π/2), with the left chunk going left and the right chunk going right. It moves up to 160px (phone 75) and fades by up to 18%. A half-moon gap opens and closes above and below the figure. Tied directly to scroll, so there is no curve.

options.figure: CSS to avoid (required) — usually screen-fixed elements
options.top · bottom · push: Image top/bottom range (px) · max push (px), default 190 · 255 · 160
options.phone · phone-top · phone-bottom · phone: Width (px) treated as a phone and its values, default 480 · 90 · 150 · 75
options.fade: Share blurred at the deepest point, default .18
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Lines to push — one line at a time (line breaks are split into line elements)
options.[data-dir=left]: For blocks containing lines of text — pushed to the left (otherwise to the right)

use: First lineSecond row

from.where: index.html .ms-story — story text lines flowing around a pinned character
